description: Amazon DynamoDB Local with DynamoDB Admin as its UI. Declare tables with --set tables=name:hash[,range][+index=hash[,range][/keys]]...[~ttl];... ; each is created on `up` when missing. Any credentials and region reach the same tables. In memory unless persist=true.

tables.help: Tables created on every `up` when missing: name:hash[,range], a key as attr or attr#N (S, N or B); +index=hash[,range] adds a global secondary index (/keys for KEYS_ONLY); ~attr turns on TTL. Separate tables with ';'.

persist.help: Keep tables and items across restarts (stored in a Docker volume until the app is destroyed).
